Results.ReviewText: Easy to put together and I  made a brisket,chili Verde from the Traeger recipe and beer can chickens.  Absolutely love it.
Results.Title: Perfect Father’s Day gift

Results.ReviewText: Recently got my grill and have absolutley loved it! Setup was a breeze thanks to the thoughtful packaging and instructions. Can't wait to for many more meals with this amazing grill!
Results.Title: AMAZING!

Results.ReviewText: Brought the Traeger 885 Ironwood yesterday from my local ACE hardware in Riverside, Ca. Hassle free purchase. I walked in and asked for their Traeger specialist as I had some questions about the new 2019 Pro vs 2019 Ironwood. After reading some reviews, I wasn't sold on having to have my phone/app as the only connection to the grill. After talking with the associate, I quickly eliminated the pro. Now it came down to the two Ironwoods. I settled for the 885 due to the much larger cooking surface...yes size does matter!!  ACE delivered my 885 this morning and I did the pre-smoke set up. Will be doing some basic chicken and veggies tomorrow for the break in....all in all, very happy with the purchase as ACE threw in a free cover, two free bags of pellets and two rubs. Also picked up the Traeger pizza stone kit.
Results.Title: 885 Ironwood

Results.ReviewText:
Did a ton of research before buying this grill. The wifi connectivity is amazing! And the built in meat thermometer is a must. The double steel side walls and the backdraft for smoke makes this thing feel solid and sleek. 

No complaints and couldn’t be happier.
Results.Title: Happy With The Grill

Results.ReviewText:
I was lusting for a Pellet Grill for some time. I hemmed and hawed for viewing different manufactures. That was until Traeger came out with the Ironwood Series.

So I caved and bought an Ironwood 650. A few cooks in,,, and I wish they had come out with this grill a long time ago. It cooks perfectly without effort. Makes me look like a much better griller then I am.

My last cook was a batch of meatballs. Cooked to perfection with a hint of smoke flavor,,, great texture throughout and juicy.

I can’t wait to spread my wings and try different cooks. I can only imagine what an Apple Pie cooked on this grill would taste like!
Results.Title: Ironwood 650

Results.ReviewText: This model is extremely easy to use. Happy I bought it!
Results.Title: Very impressed with the ironwood series.
5th traeger grill and not my last!

Results.ReviewText:
Bought the Ironwood 885 having seen it being demonstrated whilst out searching for a new BBQ
So glad we got it. Great cooking area, easy to use, solid build quality and the flavours from the cooked foods are great too. Love, love, love it :)
Results.Title: Smoking Up a Storm

Results.ReviewText: I got the Ironwood 885 about a month ago and it has been a lifesaver! I am now able to socialize with family and friends with ease knowing the probe and temp gauge on the WiFire app can keep me updated without having to be near the grill all day. I also work long hours and meal prep is a must on Sundays and this Ironwood 885 allows me to cook in mass quantities, with all sorts of meats and vegetables at once! Would recommend to anyone who wants to enjoy the most versatile grill on the market!
Results.Title: Simply the best!

Results.ReviewText: Only two weeks in , but about 10 cooks deep! The difference between my Texas Elite and Ironwood 885 is substantial. From start to cooking is so much shorter, and the moisture difference is indescribable, not to mention the time to go from smoke to sear. If you are a Traeger head or just looking for amazing food every time, this is your pit.
Results.Title: This thing rocks!

Results.ReviewText:
We bought our Traeger about a month ago. I did a lot of research, and have owned quite a few grilles. We have tried everything, propane, charcoal, natural gas, ceramic infrared, etc and never really found a product that performed as advertised. Flare ups, inconsistent heat and mechanical failures were typical. Grilling had become a burden and the fun was definitely not there. Then we purchased our Traeger. Fortunately, we had a really knowledgeable sales person, a real Traeger user, who listened to our sad grilling history and suggested the Ironwood 650. Honestly, I thought the last thing I needed was a WiFi capable grille. I now stand corrected. 

The Ironwood 650 is awesome. It has never failed to deliver fantastic meals. From pork ribs to prime rib, salmon and piazza, this is a cooking machine. Plan your meal, download the Traeger recipe, follow the instructions, hang out with your friends, monitor the Traeger from your phone, gather everyone and enjoy the results. This is delicious fun. Rapidly becoming a devotee. And it’s not just a weekend thing. I can come home, fire up the Traeger, do the prep and have a fantastic meal well under way before my wife gets home. 

Totally happy with the investment in the Ironwood 650, and looking forward to many happy experiences. The wood pellet fuel is easy to handle and seems very cost competitive when compared to charcoal or propane. Even premium lump charcoals don’t delivery the subtitle wood smoke notes that the pellets do. The WiFire handles the thermal management as well if not better than the best indoor ovens. Best of all, it’s easy. Only regret is I didn’t join the Traeger revolution sooner.
Results.Title: Ironwood 650

Results.ReviewText: My wife purchased me my first Traeger, the Ironwood 885 as an early Father’s Day gift, and I absolutely love it!  Every meal I’ve made on it has turned out way better than my prior smoker!  After never owning a Traeger before, I see myself owning one for many years to come.  You will not be disappointed in the Ironwood!
Results.Title: Love my Ironwood!

Results.ReviewText: I haven’t had this grill for two weeks yet but I’ve used it enough times (almost every day) to say the 885 is a quantum leap in great grilling. The 500° temperature is a huge improvement over my 22’s 450°. The 885 gives a real sear. The Super Smoke, Wifire, the 5° +/- from the set temperature. WOW. Smoked a 10lb pork butt last Saturday while I was on a job 10 miles from my house and was able to monitor the grill and meat for temps, add periods of Super Smoke. Just genius. Traeger has hit it out of the park with this one.
Results.Title: Just Incredible

Results.ReviewText: I got the ironwood 650 about a month ago and it has blown my mind. I have a pro34 and Timberline1300 and this grill is the perfect in-between. The size is perfect for every night  small family dinners but can also handle big briskets or pork shoulders. The D2 technology and WiFire make temperature swings a thing of the past. I could go on and on about this grill but I won’t. You will not regret this purchase. I guarantee it.
Results.Title: The real deal

Results.ReviewText: I have had the Ironwood 650 for a few weeks now and all I can say is wow. The D2 and Wifire tech is amazing. all the controls and no hassle. Easy too clean out too! Cooked so much on it so far and there is noting that this grill can't do.
Results.Title: A work horse for sure!

Results.ReviewText: Got the Ironwood 650 with front shelf and cover to use as a "daily-driver" and it is AWESOME!!!!  Heats up quickly, recovers temp SUPER quickly and we use the Wifire for recipes and remote-monitoring just about everytime we fire it up!
Results.Title: Wood-fired Excellence!!

Results.ReviewText: The Ironwood 650, simply put, is unlike any grill I have ever used. The new technology is a true game changer. Simply put, this grill gets hotter, faster, and more consistently. The Wi-Fi enabled technology is something that I have quickly learned to love. Simply put, this grill is so easy to use and makes me look like a true pit master. If you are serious about creating some next level food, the Ironwood is worth every single penny.
Results.Title: Ironwood 650 - The Bentley of Grills

Results.ReviewText: I’ve had my Ironwood for a few months now and love all the new features. This grill gets hot, fast! 500 degrees no prob as with turbo temp the wait to get max heat is much less. The new D2 drive system has saved me a ton of pellets. I’ve ran cooks overnight and temp swings are minimal thanks to double walled sides. Tons of space inside and gorgeous on the outside. Love my Ironwood!
Results.Title: Love the new D2 system!

Results.ReviewText: This grill has become a quick favorite of mine! Love the features it offers. Love the build and the look of it. Very small footprint for as much meat as you can pack on it! So Awesome
Results.Title: Awesome Grill For The Price!

Results.ReviewText: I’ve owned pellet-fed grills for years. Just got this one to replace my Yoder that was chipping paint. Love what Traeger has done in the last few years with the core tech, the WiFi connectivity, etc. With their app, you can keep an eye on your smoke while you’re away and even keep your recipes right there. Love my Traeger.
Results.Title: Huge step forward

Results.ReviewText:
Absolutely love my Traegers. 
So versatile. They are my Wood fired Convection Oven/Grill/Smoker 
Eggs, bacon, banana bread, brisket, roasts, chilli, soup, lasagna, wild game... you name you can cook it!
Results.Title: Jenn Loves Traeger Grills

Results.ReviewText: I upgraded from a 1st gen Pro 34 to this bad boy. Traeger really pulled out all the stops and it is well worth it. I always had to plan additional time for my old one to heat up but this thing fires up so fast and holds temp. I thought I would be opposed to more technology in a grill but WiFire really allows you to not be tied down when doing a 12 hour cook. Super smoke was always a feature I wanted and I'm glad they threw that in another grill besides the Timberline. Plus the bump to 500 degrees makes searing so easy. This thing can do it all!
Results.Title: BUILT LIKE A TANK!

Results.ReviewText: This is the best grill I’ve ever owned it has amazing results and it’s super easy to make things on this grill I’ll never go back to a gas grill or charcoal nothing beats this grill it was worth every penny extremely satisfied great job traeger. This is the first pellet grill I’ve ever owned and it’s absolutely phenomenal I couldn’t ask for anything more once you go to traeger pellet grills you’ll never go back to a traditional grill nothing compares great job traeger keep up the great fantastic work you’ve really outdone yourselves
Results.Title: Amazing grill

Results.ReviewText: This grill is built like a tank! The recovery temp on this grill is outstanding! i am very happy I added this grill to my arsenal.
Results.Title: Ironwood 885

Results.ReviewText: I have had both the pro 22 and 34. I decided to stepped it up to the Ironwood for the new brushless motor and Wi-Fi features. Had no idea at how much easier Starting my Traeger would be and how much quicker it comes to temperature. Also my ironwood 885 has no problem keeping temperature at 500° which makes it great for cooking my favorite steak.  The act really comes to life with the Wifire feature. Just loving my new Traeger!
Results.Title: So stoked about the new WiFi and ignite features

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill more than I love my dog... And I love my dog. Actually it's a tie between the Traeger and my dog. My dog can get me a beer from the fridge. My Traeger can't do that... Yet.
Results.Title: Dig it!

Results.ReviewText: We've had the Ironwood 650 at the house for a month now. The new grill upgrades are a terrific - new D2 augers, new shape, and the app! From quick burgers to long smoked briskets, it is easy to use, it gets to temp quickly and holds temps well. Having the ability to monitor things remotely using the WiFIRE app is a great addition.
Results.Title: Smoking made easy!

Results.ReviewText: I love the new Ironwood 885! It’s an absolute beast of a grill and I’m really impressed on the temperature recovery after I open the lid. It jumps back up to heat in no time. It of course produces insanely tasty food that doesn’t last very long around the house! This is a must have for the backyard cook!!!
Results.Title: Holy Temp Recovery

Photos.Caption: Picanha on the Ironwood 885.  You can almost hear the fire roaring

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill - It is just right!!!  The size is perfect for cooking for 2 or for a party of 10.  The adjustable second shelf is great.  The new controller has WiFire, Super Smoke, the D2 decoupled drive system allows it recover quickly, and boy can it reverse sear.  When it gets rocking sounds like a tornado inside.  I compete on the 850s but this is my go to grill at home.  It just feels good.
Results.Title: My back porch Goldilocks Grill

Results.ReviewText: The new ironwood is the new toy you want on your patio this summer! With the capabilities of wifire you’re good to go wherever you are. The extended upper rack and D2 controller both add to the game! Supersmoke some cheese or grill some steaks at 500 degrees, the ironwood has you covered!
Results.Title: Well thought, well built crafted for life!

Photos.Caption: Baby Backs Were Amazing on the Ironwood!

Results.ReviewText: The new D2 Augers are awesome. Grill heats up significantly faster than the older models, and the fact that you can control the grill by your phone is amazing! Thanks for creating such a great grill y'all!
Results.Title: Love Our Ironwood 885!!

Results.ReviewText: So happy that I purchased a new Ironwood 650.  The D2 system is not a gimmick.  There is a very noticeable difference between this grill and my old Gen 1 grill.  The ease of use is astonishing.  I use my app to control the Ironwood for most of my cooks.  This has allowed me more time to sit with family and friends while dinner cooks.  The consistency of the cook time, quality and flavor is what I'm most happy with.  I can get the same results cook after cook on this grill.  I've done high heat and low and slow with excellent results.  If you're on the fence about buying this model, or wondering if you should upgrade from a Gen 1, Do it!  You will not regret buying this model.  I'm so happy I made the decision to buy it myself.
Results.Title: Consistent quality and ease of use.

Results.ReviewText: Picked up the IronWood 650 at a local dealer a week before it dropped. Several uses later and this thing does not disappoint!  Gets very hot and holds the temp within +/- 7 degrees the entire cook. The thing weighs over 350lbs but glides on the wheels. Can’t wait to do a brisket next week!  Highly recommend this grill!!
Results.Title: Best Traeger Yet!

Results.ReviewText: I've been waiting for a new Traeger since Christmas 2018 when they sold out of the Timberline. It was worth the wait! Traeger outdid themselves on every single detail. From the simple unpackaging to assembly that a third grader could complete. The Ironwood is for everyone from beginners to experts. Operating is easier than ever with the new controller and app. I've been accustomed to the tailgater and this is a delight compared to that. I've baked stuffed chicken, slow cooked pot roast, and high heat grilled jerk chicken. All have turned out wonderful. The only thing I'm not sure of is when on super smoke, you don't see smoke rolling out like you'd expect. They say it's because blue smoke is barely visible and the white smoke is cold and stale anyways. All in all I give the Ironwood an A+. I switched my order from the Timberline to this and have no regrets. Rec Tec lovers will be crying when they see this on your deck!
Results.Title: Perfect results and simple to use

Results.ReviewText: We started with a pro blue 20 then got a pro 34 now the ironwood wow what a difference it’s my new favorite toy we supersmoked two tri-tip 5 leg quarters and 15 lollipop chicken legs it was amazing
Results.Title: Love it

Results.ReviewText:
I recently upgraded from a Traeger Lonestar Elite to the new Ironwood 650 and I love it! The new barrel shape gives you so much more grilling space, the downdraft system gives you a super smoky flavor and the WiFire technology lets you download your recipe to the grill and it does all the work while you enjoy life! All the changes and upgrades are outstanding!

The packaging even gets an A+...Traeger printed a kid’s dream log cabin on the inside of the box so after your done you cut a corner open, reverse the box, tape it back together and cut out the windows and door and the kids can go to town!

All the promotional materials on the front of the grill are magnets so you don’t have to try and get stickers off your grill.
Results.Title: Grill perfection!
